input.free_text_description: This system is a e-commerce platform that serves Customer, User roles. The platform provides capabilities for account, account repository, account client. Secondary concerns include user management functionality.

user_stories.story: As a Customer, I want to add items to my cart and complete a purchase, so that I can buy products conveniently.
As a Customer, I want to interact with account functionality, so that I can accomplish my account-related tasks.
As a Customer, I want to interact with customer functionality, so that I can accomplish my customer-related tasks.
As a Customer, I want to interact with product functionality, so that I can accomplish my product-related tasks.
As a Customer, I want to use account capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
